description: The plot illustrates the model's Eval PPL under different sparsity settings applied to Attention and FFN components at varying ratios. The x-axis is labeled "Activated Parameters Ratio(%)", has a logarithmic scale, ranges from 100 to 25, and has tick labels at 100, 75, 50, and 25. The y-axis is labeled "Eval PPL", has a linear scale, and ranges from 11.5 to 14.0 with a tick label interval of 0.5. The plot contains four lines: a red dashed line representing "Transformer" that remains steady at approximately 11.5 across the x-axis; a blue line with circle markers representing "Only MoHD FFN" that starts at around 11.4 at 100% and increases to approximately 12.3 at 25%; a green line with circle markers representing "Only MoHD ATTN" that starts at around 11.4 at 100% and increases to approximately 13.5 at 25%; and a purple line with cross markers representing "MoHD ATTN + MLP" that starts at around 11.4 at 100% and increases to approximately 13.8 at 25%.
